Проект начался с Telegram-канала. Там вы: The project began as a Russian-language Telegram channel about the history of Dalian and Lüshun, formerly Dalny and Port Arthur: their events, people, books and places. This site brings those posts together in a catalogue.
Полные тексты опубликованы в канале. На: The full Russian texts are published in the channel. Each note here has a short summary, key facts and a link to the original on Telegram. The site also makes connections that a feed can hide: the people, places and books associated with a note, its historical period and its location on the map.
Я историк и преподаватель истории. Четыр: I am a historian and history teacher. For fourteen years I worked as a researcher at the State Archive of Sverdlovsk Region in Yekaterinburg. I would not call myself a military historian, but I have spent a long time working with documents.
Уже три года я живу в Даляне (大连), бывше: I have lived in Dalian (大连), formerly Dalny, for three years. It began with a visit: I wanted to take friends around the sites of Port Arthur's defence, very close to my home. I thought I would do a little reading before we went. That led to books, memoirs, archival sources and lectures, then to an interest in all of Manchuria, where Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese interests met.
Здесь я рассказываю о людях, которые тво: Here I write about the people who made this history, books with quotations and notes in the margins, a century of events, and films and novels about the war, both good and less successful. And I share plenty of photographs.
